title: Problem adding treatment with more than 2 decimal
symptom: When adding a treatment with 3 or more decimal places, the last 2 or 3 are considered as units of insulin, e.g., 3.125 becomes 25 units, 0.148 becomes 48 units, 1.2563 becomes 563 units. The same issue occurs with carbs.
cause: The problem is likely in Simulation.class, specifically in the createTreatment method which uses a regex that incorrectly splits the decimal part.
evidence_quote: I think the problem is at Simulation.class `private void createTreatment(String allWords) { allWords = allWords.replaceAll("([0-9].[0-9])([0-9][0-9])", "$1 $2"); }`
